about: Points, income, upkeep (SPEC §3, §10). Capture: each capturing man adds the squad's CoH3 capture rate per own turn-start tick; a step (neutralise, or capture a neutral point) needs points_per_step, at most one step per tick. Income per own turn start: base plus the yields of owned points whose sector links to the HQ (VPs pay nothing). Upkeep per own active unit: share_of_price × its manpower price, at most max_manpower; the excess ÷ excess_fuel_divisor is paid in fuel; net manpower never falls below min_net_share of gross. Base fuel / munitions and the manpower-point yield are v214 values.
